purpose: Supporting comparison and capture qualification for later identified-hardware learned coloration; does not train or replace the shared native stage.
calibration: Explicit measured full-scale-sine RMS dBu at input/output, source/load impedances, shared clock and alignment evidence; native -18dBFS VU label is not physical calibration.
bounds: 1MiB capture JSON;1..64 mono pairs;250ms..4M frames per pair,8M aggregate paired frames. Native QA covers44.1..192kHz,1..32 channels,4M samples including explicit zeros.
data: Generated functional probes only. Three synthetic tanh paired captures are not actual hardware observations. No external audio downloaded or used for training.
license: GPL-3.0-or-later for new project code and generated fixtures; external recording rights require independent provenance.
remaining: Target-specific learned model and explicit optional native inference/fallback.
Measured target calibration/provenance and frozen independent quality/operating-level comparison against appropriate classical baselines.
